name: Dirge of the Great Hegemon
description: Fallen Hegemon's shattered legions. Bereaved thralls controlled by Plague Knights.
add_rules: The Executor: Must include 1 Executor (Plague Knight profile with Ranged +1 DICE, LEADER, TOUGH, cost 80d). Can still include 0-2 Plague Knights.
The Fallen: Cannot include Lord of Tumours or Amalgam.
The Lost: Max 0-2 Hounds of the Black Grail, max 0-2 Heralds of Beelzebub.
The Bereaved: Grail/Fly Thralls are 'Bereaved' — Ranged +0 DICE, cost 30d. Can have Ranged Weapons, Grenades, Musical Instrument, or Troop Flag.

Hegemon's Will: Executor or Plague Knight can take Command Bereaved ACTION. Remove any number of INFECTION MARKERS from enemy models; for each removed, issue one Command (Charge/Fight/Move/Shoot) to a Bereaved within 18". Max 1 Command per Bereaved per Turn.
Dishonoured: Cannot have Beelzebub's Axe or Black Grail Shield. Cannot have Mercenaries.
Hegemon's Last Blessing: Putrid Shotguns Limit: 3. Viscera Cannon Limit: 3 and no ELITE only restriction.

abilities: Uses Plague Knight profile with LEADER and TOUGH.
Undead Fortitude: Add -1 INJURY DICE to Injury Rolls for this model unless the attack has the FIRE keyword.
add_units.battlekit_notes: Must have a suit of Armour.
